integrity: The proof is algebraic for arbitrary fields. Exact finite-field computations are confirmatory and do not certify historical novelty or replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Only composition-idempotent derivations on free nonunital associative two-step algebras are classified; equivalence to an older formulation may remain undiscovered. Counts are labeled and not conjugacy counts. Independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Idempotent derivations and a sharp half-rank bound in free two-step associative algebras
